title: Sibling OSError test also lacks a poison pin (install-path)
description: python/tests/timing/test_time_sync.py:685 (pre-existing, mutant-verified): test_provision_persistence_failure_does_not_commit asserts current() is None and minimum_record_version == 0, both of which hold without _poison_after_persistence_failure on the install path (state was never committed). The whole suite pins install-path poison only via reentry tests (:1674, :2206), never via a persistence-hook-failure trigger. Add the same floor-channel PERSISTENCE_FAILED pin as the persist-awaitable tests.
